The Deployment Challenge For Cheap Solar

AJ Cortese

Gavekal Technologies: New Energy | 31 Aug 2026

For most of the past two decades, the solar story was about making the panel cheaper. China has solved that problem. Its manufacturers now produce just shy of 90% of the world’s solar modules, and are even more dominant in the wafers and cells that make up those modules. Thanks to massive excess capacity, they are also not making much money: module profit margins have been bouncing around near zero for the past 18 months. With equipment now a commodity, the economic value of solar will mainly come from its installation.
